title: Launcher test-count summary reports incomplete-summary for a filtered cargo test run that completed 17/17
outcome: Launcher test-count summary reports incomplete-summary for a filtered cargo test run that completed 17/17
acceptance: A focused run of a filtered `cargo test --lib <filter>` whose log ends with a complete libtest summary (e.g. 17 passed, 0 ignored, N filtered out) reports that count instead of executed=unknown/incomplete-summary, including when the log contains nested 'running 1 test' announcements
A launcher test pins this with a fixture log of that shape

completion.summary: Direct filtered cargo test now uses Cargo target framing, preserving the complete outer 17-pass summary despite nested running-1 announcements. Real subprocess fixtures pin the count and strict incomplete/quiet/error behavior. Landed in Batch D bf6772a; independent evaluation83fac4fb recorded2/2pass on identical private landed source.
